description: Secret fields of REST operations that contracts/loadcraft-openapi.json does not mark yet (writeOnly, format: password, x-secret: true or x-secret: "by-name"), read by mcp/scripts/gen-operations.mjs into mcp/src/http/generated/secrets.ts. Paths: '.' a property, '[]' every item of a list, '*' every value of a map, '[secret]' an item whose name names a secret, '*secret' a value under a key that names a secret; request paths start at body, query, header or path. An entry has reason, request, response, shape (the schema of the contract that describes a part of no declared shape a path goes through, or {undescribed: reason}) and public (fields of the answer shown on purpose, with the reason). 'without_fields' lists the operations of tools that handle secrets with no field to mark, and why. The generator refuses an unknown key, an entry a mark of the snapshot already covers (the same field or one above it) and a field the snapshot does not have.

create_ingest_token_api_v1_projects__pro.reason: the contract marks the push secret of the new token; its prefix is shown on purpose

public.prefix: the first characters of the token, its public identifier by design: shown so the token can be told apart, never enough to use it

get_execution_api_v1_projects__project_i.reason: the contract marks the cells of the rows of the flows and of their reruns by name; the whole value of each cell is masked here, and the inputs a retry replays (kept as stored, not masked by the API) are masked whole

get_execution_with_results_api_v1_projec.reason: the contract marks the cells of the rows of the flows and of their reruns by name; the whole value of each cell is masked here, and the inputs a retry replays (kept as stored, not masked by the API) are masked whole

without_fields.get_scenario_api_v1_projects__project_id: the artifact is source code: a secret is a literal inside it, masked by its value and by secret names, not by a field
without_fields.get_scenario_contract_api_v1_projects__p: names of session variables and inputs only
without_fields.get_staleness_api_scenarios__scenario_id: a drift score and a time

without_fields.get_file_content_api_v1_projects__projec: generated source code: a secret is a literal inside it, masked by its value and by secret names, not by a field
without_fields.get_feeder_preview_api_v1_projects__proj: rows of a dataset: the secret cells are the columns the dataset marks as credentials, known only from the dataset itself
without_fields.get_feeder_audit_api_v1_projects__projec: history of a dataset; the secret cells and columns of its sample rows come back redacted
without_fields.get_feeder_used_in_api_v1_projects__proj: consumers of a dataset: names and row shares
without_fields.gatling_feeder_redis_status_api_v1_proje: the state of a pool; an error text is masked by its content
without_fields.probe_feeder_against_target_api_v1_proje: the outcome of a probe; the sampled input comes back as a masked hint
without_fields.gatling_feeder_jdbc_preview_api_v1_proje: rows of a query with credential columns already hidden; other values are masked by their content
without_fields.provision_feeder_accounts_api_v1_project: created rows come back with secret-like values redacted; passwords are never returned
without_fields.get_execution_traces_api_v1_projects__pr: summaries of traces carry no attributes
without_fields.get_execution_error_traces_api_v1_projec: summaries of failed traces: no attributes, no bodies
without_fields.get_execution_trace_detail_api_v1_projec: attributes of a span sit under keys with a dot (request.headers, request.body, response.body) that a path cannot name: header values are never shown, bodies and the address are masked by field name (isSecretField, isSecretParameter) and by the shape of a value, a body of a format the mask cannot read is hidden whole
without_fields.get_execution_logs_api_v1_projects__proj: log lines are free text, masked by their content
